meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 把 iMessage 适配器装进 NanoClaw：复制适配器到 src/channels/、注册频道、安装 chat-adapter-imessage@0.1.1、跑构建与注册测试，再按你选的 local 或 remote 模式写 .env 并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你提到「add imessage」「connect imessage」「add photon」等关键词，想给 NanoClaw 接上 iMessage 频道时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage 频道
say.note: 会复制适配器，并问你要 local 还是 remote 模式

say.text: 用 Photon 远程方式接 iMessage
say.note: 会向你要 Photon 服务器 URL 和 API key

say.text: 用本机 Mac 的 iMessage 接入
say.note: 需要先给 Node 打开完全磁盘访问权限

howto.what_en: Adds iMessage to NanoClaw: copies the adapter into src/channels/, registers it, installs chat-adapter-imessage@0.1.1, builds and runs the registration test, then writes .env for local or remote mode and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say things like "add imessage" or "add photon" — i.e. when you want to add an iMessage channel to NanoClaw.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter and asks local or remote
Asks for your Photon server URL and API key

say_en.text: Connect iMessage locally on this Mac
say_en.note: Needs Full Disk Access granted to Node
